scope: frozen R full AOT plus independent bounded-best-fit suffix; no production/default/queue-capacity changes
decision: Native commandBuffer acquisition is the large measured elapsed interval, consistent with original depth4 host backpressure. BestFit is faster in all three modes in this short cohort; earlier latency direction is not a stable intrinsic regression. Defaults remain unchanged.
limitations: Method wall time includes blocking/descheduling; frame main-thread CPU time is not per-method active CPU.
Outer/native factory timers are nested, and GPU execution overlaps factory/explicit wait. Do not add them.
Callback pending includes notification lag and is not exact GPU occupancy. Source and queue construction independently confirm actual capacity4.
Next-command labels identify what will be encoded, not which older kernel caused acquisition to wait.
Short10+12-frame six-process medians do not replace stage19 time-window acceptance. No cross-campaign splicing or exact observer correction.
Increasing queue capacity is not tested and can move waits or increase intermediate memory.

chart.selection: closest measured R-detail API duration to median of six process medians
